title: My Name Is Shane, Apparently

pre.en: Why did the team win the quiz?
pre.zh: 队伍是怎么赢下比赛的？
options: Chen knew the answer to the last question.
The quizmaster changed one of their answers.

intro: 一篇新概念式的小故事：小陈跟着 Tom 一家去酒吧参加问答之夜，名字被听错，从此成了「Shane」。读的时候留意 get + 过去分词：got misheard、got registered、got called，是口语里的被动，常带「意外、倒霉」的味道。结尾有个反转。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Tom took me to quiz night at the Golden Fleece.
sentences.zh: 周三，Tom 带我去金羊毛酒吧参加问答之夜。

sentences.en: His family have had a team there for twenty years, and they rarely win.
sentences.zh: 他们家在那儿组队二十年了，很少赢。

sentences.en: To be honest, I was nervous about joining them.
sentences.zh: 说实话，跟他们一起参赛我有点紧张。

sentences.en: Quiz questions in English always make my mind go blank.
sentences.zh: 一碰到英文问答题，我脑子就一片空白。

sentences.en: The pub was so loud that when I introduced myself to the barman, my name got misheard.
sentences.zh: 酒吧里吵得要命，我跟酒保自我介绍时，他把我的名字听错了。

sentences.en: "Shane?" he shouted.
sentences.zh: 「Shane？」他大声喊。

sentences.en: Before I could make it clear that my name was Chen, our team got registered as "Shane and the Taylors".
sentences.zh: 我还没来得及说清楚我叫小陈，我们队就被登记成了「Shane 和 Taylor 一家」。

sentences.en: When Uncle Mike asked about the new name, Tom just said, "It's a long story."
sentences.zh: Mike 叔叔问起这个新队名，Tom 只说了一句：「说来话长。」

sentences.en: So I went along with it, and I got called Shane all night.
sentences.zh: 于是我就将错就错，被人叫了一晚上 Shane。

sentences.en: Later, Uncle Mike mistook me for one of Rosie's friends and asked how my sister's wedding went.
sentences.zh: 后来，Mike 叔叔把我当成了 Rosie 的朋友，还问我姐姐的婚礼办得怎么样。

sentences.en: Then a woman at the bar asked, "Were you named after the old cowboy film?"
sentences.zh: 接着，吧台边一位女士问：「你的名字是照那部老西部片起的吗？」

sentences.en: I laughed it off and told her my parents loved horses.
sentences.zh: 我打了个哈哈，说我爸妈特别喜欢马。

sentences.en: Tom's mum even went out of her way to make me a name badge.
sentences.zh: Tom 的妈妈甚至还特意给我做了个名牌。

sentences.en: And Margaret whispered, "Your secret's safe with me."
sentences.zh: Margaret 也凑过来悄悄说：「放心，我嘴可严了。」

sentences.en: Well, she's terrible at keeping secrets.
sentences.zh: 可问题是，她最守不住秘密了。

sentences.en: The quizmaster's very strict about phones, and each team is given ten rounds of questions.
sentences.zh: 主持人对手机管得很严，每队要答十轮题。

sentences.en: Our answers kept getting marked wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们的答案一个接一个被判错。

sentences.en: Pete got so stressed that he took a beer mat apart.
sentences.zh: Pete 急得把一张啤酒杯垫拆得七零八落。

sentences.en: Tom asked the quizmaster to look into one of them, but he refused.
sentences.zh: Tom 请主持人把其中一道题再查一查，可他不肯。

sentences.en: By the last question, we had the same score as a team of nurses.
sentences.zh: 到最后一题时，我们跟一队护士打成了平手。

sentences.en: It was about the Ming dynasty, and everyone turned to me.
sentences.zh: 那道题问的是明朝，大家齐刷刷看向我。

sentences.en: I wrote "1368", and we won by one point.
sentences.zh: 我写下「1368」，我们以一分之差赢了。

sentences.en: On Friday, the pub posted a photo online.
sentences.zh: 周五，酒吧在网上发了张照片。

sentences.en: "Congratulations to quiz champion Shane Taylor!"
sentences.zh: 「恭喜问答冠军 Shane Taylor！」

sentences.en: Margaret looked at it and nodded.
sentences.zh: Margaret 看了看，点点头。

sentences.en: "Well, now you're family."
sentences.zh: 「好嘛，这下你算是一家人了。」

cards.note: used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
to feel worried and a little afraid about something that is going to happen
if your mind goes blank, you suddenly cannot remember or think of anything
to tell someone your name when you meet them for the first time
cards.tip: yourself 要随人变：introduce myself / ourselves；向谁介绍用 to：introduce yourself to the team。
cards.example: Let's go round the table and introduce ourselves.

cards.note: 女性是 barmaid；现在也常说中性的 bartender 或 bar staff。
mis- 表示「错」：misread 看错、misunderstand 误解；过去式和过去分词是 misheard。
to say or show something in a way that people cannot misunderstand
register for a course 报名上课；名词 registration。
said when something is too complicated to explain now, or you do not want to explain it
cards.tip: 常常是不想解释的客气说法；讲过去的事也能说 It was a long story。
cards.example: "Why are you wearing two different shoes?" "It's a long story."

cards.note: to accept something or agree with someone, often without saying what you really think
cards.tip: 后面接想法、计划或人：go along with the idea / with Tom；常带「其实不太情愿」的意思。
cards.example: I didn't love the plan, but I went along with it.

cards.zh: 把某人错当成另一个人
cards.note: to think wrongly that one person or thing is another
cards.tip: mistake 的过去式是 mistook，过去分词 mistaken；介词用 for，不用 as。
cards.example: People often mistake me for my brother.

cards.note: to be given the same name as someone or something
cards.tip: 英式用 named after，美式也说 named for；人、街道、城市、船都能用。
cards.example: The street was named after a famous doctor.

cards.note: Shane 是 1953 年一部很有名的美国西部片；英式口语里 cowboy 还指「不靠谱的工人」。
to laugh about something to show that it does not worry or upset you
cards.tip: 代词放中间：laugh it off；常用于尴尬、出错、被批评的场合。
cards.example: She fell over on stage, but she laughed it off.

cards.text: go out of your way to do
cards.note: to make a special effort to do something, especially to help someone
cards.tip: your 要换成对应的人：out of her way；后面接 to do。
cards.example: Our neighbour went out of his way to help us move in.

cards.note: 开会、活动时别在胸前写名字的牌子叫 name badge。
to not tell other people something that you have been asked not to tell
to separate something into its different parts
cards.tip: 东西放在 take 和 apart 中间；装回去是 put sth back together。
cards.example: My son took the old radio apart to see how it worked.

cards.note: 英国酒吧桌上的纸板杯垫，紧张时有人会把它撕碎。
to try to find out the facts about a problem
cards.tip: 工作里常说 I'll look into it（我查一下）；into 不能换成 in。
cards.example: I'll look into why the payment failed.

cards.note: the Ming dynasty 明朝，the Tang dynasty 唐朝；dynasty 小写，朝代名大写。
